Factor tiers:
- lapse (`reinstatement_fee_by_time_since_expiry`): 19 days ≥ 15 → 150 % → $52.50.

- usage (`usage_credit_and_low_use_surcharge`): 6 used of 12 (≥ half) → engagement credit −$5.00.
- restoration (`visit_restoration_charge`): latest expiry entry 5 visits → 5 × $4.00 = +$20.00.
Charge = 47.25 − 20 − 15 − 5 + 20 = **$27.25**; visits_restored **5**; new_expiry_date 2026-10-05 + 30 = **2026-11-04**; payment card.

**(b) Refund.** Base clause after the window is retired (`cancellation_and_refund_rules`); current basis `prorated_refund_amount`: money paid toward the price $1236.00 (reinstatement fee excluded) − visits used 6 × $125.00 − admin fee $35.00 = fall-back **$451.00**.
Factor tiers:
- used-visit valuation (`used_visit_valuation_with_insurance_or_discount`): plan for M54.50 opened 2026-07-08 > purchase 2026-03-20, not closed → 1236/12 = $103.00 → value used $618.00.
- unused-visit cap (`refund_ceiling_for_reinstated_or_received_visits`): reinstated after (a) → standing 5 × $103.00 × 80 % = $412.00; 1236 − 618 = 618 → capped at $412.00.
- admin fee waiver (`refund_administrative_fee_waiver`): 2 clinic cancellations → $0.00.
- forfeit charge (`forfeited_visit_charge_on_refund`): 1 forfeit, a no-show → 1 × $103.00.
- installment service fee (`installment_service_fee_on_refund`): 2 installment payments → $10.00.
- handling charge (`reinstated_package_handling_charge`): reinstated, no package visit used since → $15.00.
Refund = 412.00 − 0 − 103.00 − 10.00 − 15.00 = **$284.00**; visits_unused **5**.
